description.zh:
标签所属的资源的ID。
- 当ResourceType为Instance时，需要配置为数据集加速实例ID，如何获取加速实例ID，请参见[ListInstances](~~467899~~)。
- 当ResourceType为Slot时，需要配置为数据集加速槽ID，如何获取数据集加速槽ID，请参见[ListSlots](~~467905~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the resource to which the tag belongs.

- If ResourceType is Instance, set this parameter to the dataset acceleration instance ID. For more information about how to obtain the instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

- If ResourceType is Slot, set this parameter to the dataset acceleration slot ID. For more information about how to obtain the slot ID, see [ListSlots](~~467905~~).

description.zh:
标签所属的资源的类型，取值如下：
- Instance：数据集加速实例。
- Slot：数据集加速槽。
description.en:
The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Valid values:

- Instance: dataset acceleration instance.

- Slot: dataset acceleration slot.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator delete-tag --resource-type Instance --resource-id inst-my1tk3jggooi5uwks --key dataset_version --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator DELETE /api/v1/tags --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId 'inst-my1tk3jggooi5uwks' --ResourceType Instance --Key dataset_version --header "Content-Type=application/json"
